# Manak (मानक)

> A zero-dependency, self-hosted hackathon submission, calibrated judging, and Ed25519-verifiable awards platform built with Node.js 22/24 and native SQLite.

## System Overview & Technical Highlights
Manak resolves the core operational challenges of competitive hackathons: evaluator variance, reviewer panel coverage gaps, score secrecy leaks, and unverified award credentials. The system is built with zero runtime npm dependencies, deterministic mathematical algorithms, append-only cryptographic ledgers, and a single command-driven pipeline declaring 112 operations and 627 automated tests.

- **Live Deployment**: https://manak.up.railway.app (Fast Login enabled for immediate role testing)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ewwhardik/manak
- **Author**: Sai Ram Dash (Hardik)
- **Runtime Stack**: Node.js 22.18+ (Node 24 recommended), native `node:sqlite`, native `node:crypto`, native `node:test`.
- **Zero Production Dependencies**: Zero npm packages in production; fully self-contained.
- **Specification Claims**: Complete implementation and verification of T1, T2, T3, T4, and all 4 bonus challenges.
- **Verification Suite**: 627 automated tests (626 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed), 100% core pass rate.

## Evaluation Personas (1-Click Fast Login)
On the live deployment or local demo (`npm run start:demo`), the top navigation **Fast login** menu allows instant testing of all role workspaces without requiring email relays:
- **Visitor**: Public project gallery, search and track filtering, event schedule and tracks, announcements feed.
- **Builder (`Priya Nair` / `Beatriz Lima`)**: Team workspace, recruitment directory, member invites, markdown draft persistence, deadline enforcement.
- **Judge (`Tomas Varga` / `Nils Berg`)**: Blind evaluation queue, weighted rubric sliders, draft auto-saving, pairwise duels (`/duel`). Peer scores and recused projects are strictly isolated.
- **Organizer (`Rosa Iyer`)**: Real-time Organizer Dashboard (`/events/:slug/dashboard`), Bayesian judge leniency/severity diagnostics, panel coverage graphs, repeated title collision alerts, bipartite assignment optimizer, finalist tie-breaker assistant (`/tie-breaker`), rival comparison engine (`/compare`), 2FA security, and certificate studio.
- **Stage / Public**: Live podium ceremony leaderboard (`/events/:slug/live`) with native 5s auto-refresh.
- **Public Verifier**: Offline Ed25519 WebCrypto certificate verification terminal (`/verify`).

## Automated Verification Suite & Reproduction Commands
Execute locally in repository root (requires Node.js 22.18+):
- `npm test`: Runs full suite of 627 automated tests (626 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed).
- `python run.py .dogfood.toml`: Runs official DogFood T1/T2 acceptance harness.
- `python tools/check_extended.py .dogfood.toml --allow-incomplete`: Runs 28/28 verified extended acceptance test suite.
- `npm run prove:normalization -- --check`: Verifies Bayesian normalization across 59 configurations and 1,180 simulated events.
- `npm run prove:convergence -- --check`: Verifies bounded convergence schedules and held-out RMSE.
- `npm run prove:fixtures -- --check`: Verifies deterministic evaluation against official 41-project, 126-ballot fixture.
- `npm run prove:isolation -- --check`: Verifies 1,344 permission-boundary probes across 6 witnesses with zero unauthorized state mutations.
- `npm run prove:roundtrip -- --check`: Verifies archive export/import roundtrip across 35 strict tables and 11 corrupted archive refusals.
- `npm run audit:commits`: Verifies all repository commits fall strictly within the authorized hackathon submission window.
